frequency_question: How often have federal education authorities stripped an institutional or programmatic accreditor of its recognition status over comparable modern regulatory cycles?
membership_rule: Members are federal reviews of nationally recognized accrediting agencies (such as regional or specialized accreditors under the US Department of Education) where de-recognition or termination of authority was formally proposed or evaluated. Excluded are voluntary relinquishments of accreditation authority without federal enforcement action.

cases.name: ACICS recognition termination proceeding (Obama/Trump administration transition era)

coverage_note: 5 named major review instances; representative of high-stakes federal accreditor oversight battles.
known_gaps: Does not capture minor administrative warnings that never reached formal termination proceedings.
skeleton: 5 distinct major federal review cycles of prominent accreditors evaluated over multi-year windows
multiplier: 2 hits out of 5 observed major contested review cycles
validity_reason: Statutory oversight frameworks and Department of Education review procedures for accreditors remain stable across multi-year administrative cycles.
